answer: The March 2026 drop comes from a change in HbA1c reporting units, not from worse glycemic control. Starting 2026-03-30, some organizations report HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) in IFCC mmol/mol instead of NGSP %, in the same value_num column; only the units column changes. A 'value_num < 7' test counts results like 44 mmol/mol (6.2%) as not under 7. Converting mmol/mol to % (NGSP = IFCC / 10.929 + 2.15) before applying the threshold removes the drop. Data note: the 10k P2 pack was not on this machine, so this was found on the committed fixture-100 (planted). There the March drop shows in the panel-wide HbA1c result rate (100% to 75% raw, 100% normalized); the fixture's 3-4 patient type 2 diabetes cohort had no March HbA1c, so its rate does not move.

findings.title: HbA1c results switch from % to mmol/mol starting 2026-03-30
findings.summary: From 2026-03-30, 9 of 21 HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) results are reported with units 'mmol/mol' (values 7-54) instead of '%'. There are none before March 2026. They come from 8 organizations, none of which reported a % HbA1c after its first mmol/mol result, which fits a per-organization lab or interface change. Each converted value is consistent with the same patient's earlier % results (for example, 54 mmol/mol = 7.1% for a patient previously at 7.1%).
entities: 3e97ce4f-3ad7-3cea-883f-e2bb4ca89d83 HALLMARK HEALTH URGENT CARE PHYSICIANS LLC
sql:
select o.date::date as date, o.patient, o.value_num, o.units, round(o.value_num / 10.929 + 2.15, 1) as pct,
       e.organization, g.name as organization_name,
       o.patient in (select patient from conditions
                     where (system = 'SNOMED-CT' and code = '44054006')
                        or (system in ('ICD-10-CM', 'ICD10') and code like 'E11%')) as is_t2d
from observations o join encounters e on e.id = o.encounter join organizations g on g.id = e.organization
where o.code = '4548-4' and o.units = 'mmol/mol' order by o.date;

findings.title: A raw '< 7' threshold reads mmol/mol values as uncontrolled; normalizing removes the March drop
findings.summary: Share of HbA1c results under 7%: 100% in every month from 2025-11 to 2026-02, then 75% in March 2026 on raw values (1 of 4 results is 44 mmol/mol). After converting mmol/mol to %, March 2026 is 100%. The raw rate stays depressed afterward (0%, 25%, 33.3%, 66.7%), while the normalized rate is 100% in most months. The one normalized miss is a true value of 7.1% or higher.
sql:
with a1c as (
  select patient, date, value_num, units,
         case when units = 'mmol/mol' then round(value_num / 10.929 + 2.15, 1) else value_num end as pct
  from observations where code = '4548-4')
select strftime(date, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as tests,
       sum((value_num < 7)::int) as under7_raw, round(100.0 * sum((value_num < 7)::int) / count(*), 1) as pct_raw,
       sum((pct < 7)::int) as under7_normalized, round(100.0 * sum((pct < 7)::int) / count(*), 1) as pct_normalized,
       sum((units = 'mmol/mol')::int) as mmol_results
from a1c where date >= '2025-10-01' group by 1 order by 1;

findings.title: Fixture-size caveat: the fixture's type 2 diabetes cohort does not show the March drop
findings.summary: The P2 10k pack was missing, so the analysis used fixture-100. There, the type 2 diabetes cohort (SNOMED 44054006 or ICD-10-CM E11%, alive, latest HbA1c in the trailing 12 months) is only 3-4 patients, and none had an HbA1c in March 2026, so the cohort rate is flat (33.3%) through April 2026. The cohort's only mmol/mol result (54 mmol/mol = 7.1%, 2026-09-07) is genuinely not under 7. With the 10k panel, the same units switch would reach the cohort's March results. Re-run this SQL against P2 analytics.duckdb to size it.
sql:
with t2d as (select patient, min(start) as onset from conditions
             where (system = 'SNOMED-CT' and code = '44054006')
                or (system in ('ICD-10-CM', 'ICD10') and code like 'E11%')
             group by 1),
a1c as (select patient, date, value_num, units,
               case when units = 'mmol/mol' then round(value_num / 10.929 + 2.15, 1) else value_num end as pct
        from observations where code = '4548-4'),
months as (select (d + interval 1 month - interval 1 day)::date as month_end, strftime(d, '%Y-%m') as month
           from range(date '2025-10-01', date '2026-10-01', interval 1 month) t(d)),
latest as (
  select m.month, a.patient, arg_max(a.value_num, a.date) as raw, arg_max(a.pct, a.date) as pct,
         arg_max(a.units, a.date) as units
  from months m
  join t2d t on t.onset <= m.month_end
  join patients p on p.id = t.patient and (p.deathdate is null or p.deathdate > m.month_end)
  join a1c a on a.patient = t.patient and a.date::date <= m.month_end and a.date::date > m.month_end - interval 12 month
  group by all)
select month, count(*) as denom,
       round(100.0 * sum((raw < 7)::int) / count(*), 1) as pct_raw,
       round(100.0 * sum((pct < 7)::int) / count(*), 1) as pct_normalized,
       sum((units = 'mmol/mol')::int) as latest_in_mmol
from latest group by 1 order by 1;
